# kAIxu CodeStudio Pro

A SOLEnterprises / Skyes Over London developer command platform. The package contains a public landing site, offline-first PWA app, executable Node backend engine, provider-pack actions, workflow action registry, signed upstream-claim verification, webhook idempotency and replay, queue controls, storage adapters, proof receipts, and reports.

Primary routes:
- / — product landing website
- /app/ — platform application
- /reports/ — report index
- /platform/platform-manifest.json — package manifest
- /platform/proof/backend-smoke-report.json — backend fixture smoke proof

Live-provider claim boundary: live Stripe, Resend, Twilio, Cloudflare, Netlify, Neon/Postgres, Google, and gateway proof requires real environment secrets. Without secrets, providers block honestly.
